_comment: Persona B-inverse: persona B with every weight's sign flipped, the screen kept.
B:         caffeine_content 0, leaf_size  100, oxidation_level  20, steeping_time -50, resteep_potential -70
B-inverse: caffeine_content 0, leaf_size -100, oxidation_level -20, steeping_time  50, resteep_potential  70
caffeine_content screened at 50% of its range (35 mg), as B.
data/minimum_threshold_one_persona/inverse/one_persona_minimum_threshold_b_inverse/: A's input files with only the first row of instilled_weights.csv
changed, built with the same seeds, so its 5000 training prompts are the same as A's, B's and A-inverse's. C and
screen-decided trials are the same as theirs; every trial decided by the weights alone gets the opposite of B's answer.
Everything else, questions, "{" reply prefix and C in report trials included, is one_persona_probes_a.json's.
